cohort: 4658 pregnant females presenting for delivery at a tertiary care hospital in Lahore, Pakistan
finding: The frequency of placenta previa was low (4.7% of cesarean deliveries) but associated with high complications, particularly hysterectomy.
mod_finding: 51.6% of the cohort had a spontaneous vaginal delivery, while 48.4% had a cesarean section; placenta previa occurred in 4.7% of the cesarean deliveries.
followup_time: until delivery of fetus and placenta
